usage.outputShape: body.content (string, the model reply); body.model; body.usage.total_tokens / body.usage.cost
quirks: Reply text is at body.content (top level), NOT body.choices[0].message.content like OpenAI-style responses.
Model id in response is cohere/command-a-03-2025.
usage.guide: Send a POST with a JSON body containing a messages array of {role, content} objects (OpenAI chat shape). Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.04 per call (varies with token usage). The model's reply text is returned directly at body.content as a plain string; token/cost metadata is at body.usage. Synchronous — the answer is in the immediate 200 response, no polling.
